definitions.explanation: A facility that looks after babies and young children during the day while their parents work. The official term in law and administration; in everyday speech people usually say {保育園|ほいくえん}.

examples.japanese: {保育所|ほいくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: To leave one's child at a day nursery.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{保育所|ほいくしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: There aren't enough day nurseries nearby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{待機児童|たいきじどう}→待機児童：08624_taikijidou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{保育所|ほいくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦{開設|かいせつ}した→開設する：30272_kaisetsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To reduce the number of children on waiting lists, the city opened three new day nurseries.

notes:
{保育所|ほいくしょ} and ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧ name the same kind of facility; {保育所|ほいくしょ} is the legal and official term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保育所|ほいくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧: to leave (a child) at a nursery
- {認可|にんか}{保育所|ほいくしょ}: licensed day nursery
- {保育所|ほいくしょ}{不足|ぶそく}: shortage of day nurseries

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧: day nursery (the everyday word)
- ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧: kindergarten (an educational institution for ages 3–6, usually with shorter hours)
